title: Koltukta uyuyan

characters.DAD: a father in his fifties with short greying hair and glasses, wearing a navy blue work jacket
characters.SON: a young man of about twenty-five with short brown hair, wearing a grey hoodie

scenes.prompt: In the evening, {DAD} carries two heavy grocery bags up an apartment staircase lit by a warm lamp, autumn leaves visible through the stairwell window.

scenes.text:
Musluğu o tamir etti,
faturayı o ödedi, seni o taşıdı.
scenes.prompt: In a kitchen in warm evening light, {DAD} kneels in front of the open cabinet under the sink, fixing the pipe with a focused face.

scenes.text:
Ama her akşam haberlerin ortasında
koltukta uyuyakaldı.
scenes.prompt: In a living room lit by a floor lamp, {DAD} is asleep in an armchair with his glasses slipping down his nose, rain on the window behind him.

scenes.text:
Sen "Yine uyudu" diye güldün;
o aslında yorgunluğunu söylüyordu.
scenes.prompt: {SON} stands in the living room doorway on the left smiling, looking at {DAD} asleep in the armchair on the right, warm lamp light.

scenes.text:
Bu akşam üstünü sen ört.
Bunu babana gönder.
scenes.prompt: In the lamp-lit living room, {SON} gently lays a soft blanket over {DAD}, who sleeps peacefully in the armchair, rain falling outside the window.

caption:
Baban yorgun mu?

Babalar yorgunluğu söylemez, koltukta uyuyakalır. 🤍

Bunu babana gönder.
